DIRECTLY_USABLE_FOR_BUILD.usage: Routes project type to recommended architecture and starter template
Classifies evidence by quality tier, prevents process-artifact-as-product confusion
Machine-readable pass/fail checks with negative controls
Every check designed to FAIL when wrong, no PASS-by-default
Pre-build quality gate and evidence check, readonly
New Codex window can pick up state without conversation memory
Conditional multi-agent collaboration, not default but operational
Phase completion and handoff evidence chains

AUXILIARY_FOR_BUILD.usage: Verifies claims against implementation, auxiliary to build verification
Detects false PASS, self-report-only, fake tests — protects build integrity
Detects cross-run pollution, protects build state isolation
Specialized diagnostic for academic projects, auxiliary
Fast first-pass structural check, auxiliary gate

NOT_YET_BUILT.description: Accept project path/requirements, auto-classify, route to mode
Judge project complexity: file count, auth presence, DB presence, multi-app, risk level
Generate dependency-ordered task graph from requirements and architecture
Allocate task graph nodes to agents with clear write-scope boundaries
Merge agent outputs, resolve conflicts, verify integration contracts
File-based state that persists across sessions and agents
Resume complex project across multiple sessions without losing context
External knowledge base for project-specific decisions and patterns
Iterate on complex project across days/weeks with state preservation

NOT_YET_BUILT.capability: Real Complex Project Delivery Closed Loop
NOT_YET_BUILT.description: End-to-end: intake → build → verify → repair → deliver → handoff

USE_WITH_CAUTION.caution: Has process evidence, no product superiority over Vanilla. Use conditionally for large projects.
Not suitable as default. Only considered for >20 module projects with clear boundaries.
Measures outcomes, does not build. Only meaningful after build harness operational.
Packaging without proven build capability is premature. Gate behind Build Mode success.
Evidence trial complete. Do not reopen as product.

criticalGapAssessment: 10 of 26 needed capabilities are MISSING. Core Build Harness capabilities (intake, classifier, task graph, external memory, delivery closed loop) are all MISSING. Existing capabilities are strong on verification and safety, weak on production and coordination.
